subject: Assurance intake: rolling artifact batches + redaction playbook
messages:
From: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@harvestbank.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Harvest Bank Procurement <procurement@harvestbank.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / ISO mapping + evidence cadence for procurement review

Laura —

Thanks for taking this on. Procurement has a condensed review window for our vendor shortlist and they need a compact package to kick off security review. Two asks from our side:

1) Can you provide an initial artifact batch by next Friday (2027-03-26) that includes: SOC 2 Type II (or bridge), a control crosswalk mapping SOC/ISO controls to Redwood controls, a redacted network diagram, and a sample of KMS key-rotation evidence?

2) We understand some artifacts are large or contain PII. Would Redwood be able to deliver the remaining artifacts in weekly rolling batches (4 total), with a clear redaction legend and a point-of-contact for evidence questions?

Also, procurement may request a signed access NDA before we share deeper artifacts. Please advise on expected timelines and if any items require legal approval.

Tom
Tom Briggs
Sr. Procurement Manager
Harvest Bank

Attachment: Harvest_Security_Questionnaire_SIG.xlsx (xls, 1.1MB)
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@harvestbank.com>
Cc: procurement@harvestbank.com
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / ISO mapping + evidence cadence for procurement review

Tom —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can support a rolling delivery model. Proposed plan:

- Initial batch (2027-03-26): SOC2-Type2-2026-bridge.pdf, control-crosswalk-harvest-2027.csv, network-diagram-redacted.png, kms-rotation-sample.log (sample entries, timestamps redacted except rotation events).
- Weekly follow-ups: deeper telemetry retention samples, access review logs (redacted), vulnerability scanning summaries, and an ISO 27001 Annex A cross-reference export.

Redaction approach: we will produce a redaction legend and apply tokenization to any PII or customer-identifying strings. We will also provide a separate unredacted index for your security team to review under an NDA or secure viewer.

Point people:
- Primary contact for artifacts: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
- Evidence pull & KMS proof: jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
- Control mapping questions: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

I will provision a locked Drive folder and share a DocuSign link for a one-way confidentiality addendum if you require it before we send unredacted samples. Expect the Drive link in my next message; consider this email confirmation of the schedule.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Trust & Assurance | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 10:30:45 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Harvest Bank - rolling artifact batches (action items)

Team — forwarding Harvest Bank procurement request. TL;DR: initial compact package due 2027-03-26, then weekly rolling batches. Please action below items and copy me when completed.

Action list:
1) Jordan: pull KMS rotation events for the last 12 months and produce a sample log (kms-rotation-sample.log). Redact principal ARNs and session tokens, but keep rotation timestamps and signature hashes. Provide a short README describing how to validate rotation events against our KMS. Due: 2027-03-24 EOD.

2) Neha: finalize the control crosswalk (SOC/ISO -> Redwood controls). Use the CSV template I attached and include column for evidence filename and last-modified date. Include a note where evidence will be redacted and why. Due: 2027-03-24 EOD.

3) Ops: generate a redacted network diagram (network-diagram-redacted.png) and a short paragraph explaining our network segmentation model for customers on Redwood Private vs Dedicated. Due: 2027-03-24 EOD.

Notes: we should avoid sending raw logs that contain customer IDs. If Harvest wants an unredacted view, we will route through the secure share + NDA. Jordan — coordinate with Infra to get the signed checksum for the sample logs.

Thanks — Laura
